prompts.text: Honors College, WISE or University Scholars: Please discuss why you are a good fit for your preferred University Honors Program (Honors College, WISE or University Scholars).

applies_to.program: Honors College, WISE or University Scholars

prompts.quote: Upload to your StartSBU Portal one brief honors statement. Applicants should keep their honors application statement to approximately 250 words. This honors statement is a required document for honors program consideration, but please note if applying to more than one program, only one statement for your preferred program is required (this does not apply to the Simons STEM application process).
